text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature lost the race. However, unlike 
before, she positively vowed to use this 
defeat to improve for next time.

And so, Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, 
who are also heading off to train for 
their next race just like her, make a 
promise for a rematch.

Convinced that with her current strength 
she can run with confidence even on the 
grandest stage, her Trainer proposes 
entering the autumn Tenno Sho.

Nice Nature fired herself up whenever she 
felt faint-hearted, strengthening her 
resolve to take on the grand stage.
